jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they’re among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That’s a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We’ve raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

As a Project Manager at Sona, you’ll lead the coordination of an Implementation Pod consisting of a Solutions Architect and a Solutions Specialist, and together you’ll own a portfolio of enterprise implementations for our customers.

You’ll run implementations of Sona’s products (HR, Scheduling, Payroll, LMS & ATS) end to end, ensuring delivery meets our scope commitments, budgets and timelines, all while providing an exceptional experience for our customers. You’ll partner closely with senior stakeholders from our customers and internally across our Commercial, Product and Customer teams. We’re a growing business, so you’ll also need to thrive in a fast-evolving environment and be a strong advocate for clarity and communication.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver projects on time, within scope and budget, maintaining the highest quality standards.

  • Manage project risks, dependencies and scope, communicating mitigations and changes clearly to all stakeholders.

  • Act as the primary customer advocate, building strong relationships and managing expectations throughout delivery.

  • Coordinate internal teams, vendors and customers to ensure successful outcomes and efficient resource deployment.

  • Produce clear, consistent documentation and status reports, escalating risks where required.

  • Support our Land and Expand approach by driving strong customer partnerships and early value realisation.

  • Continuously improve project processes and tools to enhance delivery speed, quality and customer satisfaction.

Requirements

  • Proven success delivering enterprise software implementation projects on time, within budget and scope.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with C-level executives.

  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, able to influence without direct authority.

  • Strategic thinker with strong risk management, planning and prioritisation capabilities.

  • Calm, organised and results-driven under pressure, with excellent time management.

  • Confident in presenting, reporting and managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.

  • Bonus: experience with workforce management or HR software, experience managing customers in a frontline or operationally complex industry.

Benefits

  • Salary: £70,000 - £80,000 per annum

  • Hybrid working pattern (2+ days per week in our London office, plus customer travel across the UK)

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Professional development budget

  • Unlimited free books

Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Security
jobs.jd_full:
Lead Product Manager, Security

Summary

Wikipedia is a trusted source of knowledge the world over, read by over a billion people a month in over 300 languages. It’s offered for free and operated independently by a non-profit (that’s us) powered mainly by small donations.

Wikimedia’s Product Safety and Integrity team is charged with keeping Wikipedia a stable and trustworthy place, and protecting its many contributors and readers.

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to bring their experience dealing with modern threats to bear on Wikipedia’s security strategy in the AI era, and to drive a strong security culture throughout the Wikimedia Foundation and movement.

Though this is a senior role, prior experience in a product manager role is not required. This position is intended to bring strong technical and security experience, including some familiarity with AI in a security context, into a role focused on product and platform strategy.

This position could be a good fit for a candidate with both strong technical skills and strong communication skills, who is interested in transitioning from engineering work to a strategic role.

This role is an opportunity to be at the center of a pivotal time for Wikipedia, as AI is not only changing security, but also how people access knowledge online. Responding to these changes requires us to plan ambitiously and act decisively, while working closely with the communities whom the project serves.

This role reports to the Group Product Manager, Safety and Security.

You are responsible for:

  • Shaping the Wikimedia Foundation’s product security strategy, and strengthening our team and organizational security culture.
  • Determining and driving the priorities of a team of engineers focused on security and privacy, and leveraging the support of a cross-functional team of designers, data scientists, community managers, and others across the Product Safety and Integrity team.
  • Driving the design and development of technical features and interventions that make it easier for users to safely get things done, and that make it harder for bad actors to compromise the platform.
  • Communicating strategically and candidly, in public and private settings, with community members about our work.
  • Establishing strong working relationships with volunteers, acting as a representative and conduit between the Wikimedia community and Foundation on security and privacy issues.
  • Partnering closely with leaders in other departments to shape WMF’s overall information security posture.
  • Actively staying up to date on current developments in online security and privacy, including vulnerability research and development.

Skills and Experience:

  • At least 7 years of professional experience working in teams that build products, including at least 2 years of that time in a security-focused role.
  • Experience driving significant security initiatives all the way out the door, in either a senior technical or product management capacity.
  • Significant professional experience at using AI-based tools to perform security analysis, and other technical tasks, such as code review and software engineering.
  • Comfortable using and learning command-line-based tools as needed.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with all levels of management, staff, and communities.
  • Capable of managing a diverse range of responsibilities in a dynamic and results-oriented environment.

Qualities that are important to us:

  • Belief that Wikipedia and its community model is a good thing in the world.
  • Ability to be decisive and expeditious despite a complex set of stakeholders, including volunteers who perform critical work for the projects.
  • Experience working with online communities, especially public ones.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501©(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries *. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$ 133,121to US$ 207,388 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:

US States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)

Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. ( *citizens/permanent residents only)

We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at recruiting@wikimedia.org or +1 (415) 839-6885.

jobs.title: Network installation project manager EV
jobs.jd_full:
Description

Join Allego and power the future of clean mobility

Allego is one of Europe’s leading providers of fast and ultra-fast charging solutions for electric vehicles. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to sustainable mobility by deploying reliable, high-performance and accessible charging infrastructure.

Operating across 16 European countries, Allego already manages an extensive public charging network and continues to expand through hundreds of new projects every year.

The EV market is moving fast, and so are we. That’s why we’re looking for a Network Development Manager to drive the expansion of Allego’s ultra-fast charging network across Spain.

About the role

In this role, you will be reporting to the Director of Network Development and will work closely with our Network Planning, Legal, Delivery and Operations teams.

This is what you will primarily be doing:

  • Identify, assess and develop new charging site opportunities across Spain in line with Allego’s growth strategy.

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of development opportunities through prospecting, market analysis and strategic partnerships.

  • Negotiate and finalize site agreements and commercial conditions with landowners, retailers, fuel station operators, real estate developers and municipalities, in line with Allego’s investment criteria.

  • Evaluate commercial feasibility, investment cases and expected returns for new charging locations.

  • Assess project feasibility, considering technical, regulatory, grid and commercial constraints.

  • Drive projects from origination through development, coordinating all key activities required before implementation.

  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders including landowners, business partners, legal advisors, grid operators, permitting consultants and local authorities.

  • Act as the primary point of contact throughout the development phase, ensuring alignment on scope, timelines and project objectives.

  • Initiate permitting, grid connection and technical feasibility processes in close collaboration with specialist teams.

  • Proactively identify project risks, bottlenecks and dependencies and implement mitigation measures.

  • Ensure projects are properly documented and prepared for handover to Delivery teams once contractual and development milestones have been achieved.

  • Represent Allego in the Spanish market and build strong relationships with strategic stakeholders to support long-term growth.

Requirements

This is you

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Engineering or a related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in business development, site acquisition, infrastructure development, commercial real estate or a comparable sector.

  • Strong commercial mindset with a proven track record of negotiating and closing agreements.

  • Experience managing projects from opportunity identification through contract signature and development.

  • Ability to evaluate business cases and commercial feasibility.

  • Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills.

  • Experience in EV charging, renewable energy, mobility, infrastructure or retail real estate is highly desirable.

  • Perfectly fluent in Spanish and also fluent in English.

  • Willing to travel regularly across Spain.

  • Holder of a valid driver’s license.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary between 40k and 50k annually.

  • Company car.

  • A flexible, inclusive and international work environment.

  • The opportunity to build Allego’s presence and growth in one of Europe’s most dynamic EV markets.

  • Genuine career growth opportunities across Europe.

  • A collaborative and entrepreneurial culture.

  • Real impact on the energy transition and the future of mobility.

jobs.jd_full:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Two Six Technologies is seeking a highly motivated and entrepreneurial cleared Senior Product Manager to join a new, dynamic Internal Research and Development (IR&D) team focused on scaling Helix, our Agentic AI orchestration product. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of a major company initiative, collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and capture to drive competitive advantage from building a reusable agentic orchestration layer targeted at specific mission applications.

About the Team

Agentic AI is poised to revolutionize how information, intelligence, and cyber professionals operate. It promises to deliver the flexibility and rigor they need while providing intuitive, user-centric workflows that empower faster, more confident decision-making. We’re making a significant investment in this technology because we believe that:

• Software should make more decisions on behalf of the user.

• Trust in AI is built through frequent high-value user-centric experiences.

• A blend of commercial software and government services can accelerate AI adoption.

Our team is dedicated to creating an industry-leading agentic technology for critical applications like collection management, intelligence analysis, decision support, and cyber and information operations. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of AI in high-stakes environments, we want you on our team.

This is a fully remote position with flexibility to manage your day around collaboration with your team. DC location is preferred but not required. Some travel will be required to interface with our customers and Two Six employees collaborating on cleared programs.

What you will do:

• Work with customers and stakeholders to develop a product vision for the agentic AI orchestrator

• Conduct market research, solicit customer feedback, and test new ideas to build our backlog and roadmap

• Collaborate in a cross functional team to build agentic AI functionality

• Write clear and well-bounded users stories that keep the team focused on delivering slices of user value every sprint

• Engage stakeholders in the innovation process and keep them informed of your work

• Advocate for solving customer problems by building functionality into the product line

• Collaborate with other PMs to build value across product lines

• Advocate for a user-centered culture and drive change in that direction

• Be open and flexible to jump in where help is needed

What you will need (basic qualifications):

• Experience with data scientists to build AI into the pipeline is required; experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LangFlow, MCP, A2A, MCPApps, and RAG is a key differentiator

• Experience working with leadership, customers, and internal stakeholders to build products that solve hard problems

• Strong familiarity with the role of a Product Manager and PM tools for discovery and delivery, including creating rapid prototypes to quickly test new product ideas

• Experience working in scrum/kanban on cross functional teams

• Team mentality to do what’s best for the product

Nice to haves:

• Experience creating products for government users, particularly in environments with limitations on technology access and ability to interface with users

• Experience applying systems thinking to platform technologies, including modular and configuration-driven software development

• Experience with advanced analytics, natural language processing, large language models and generative AI

• Interest in supporting US government missions to counter foreign adversaries with excellence in intelligence analysis, and electronic and cyber warfare

jobs.title: Project Manager, Marketing
jobs.jd_full:
The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative was founded in 2015 by Priscilla Chan and Mark Zuckerberg to harness the power of technology to pursue some of society’s most ambitious goals — from curing or preventing all disease to transforming how students learn.

At CZI, you’ll join a deeply collaborative, mission-driven community where your work helps drive breakthroughs across our flagship nonprofit organizations, Biohub and Learning Commons. Whether enabling scientific breakthroughs via open science and AI-powered biology or strengthening the tools teachers and students rely on every day, your contributions help turn bold ideas into real-world impact.

Our teams operate at the intersection of innovation and scale, building the infrastructure, partnerships, and capabilities that allow scientists, educators, and innovators to tackle some of the most complex challenges of our time — and to do so with urgency, integrity, and optimism.

The Team

The Operations team is a key partner in enabling Biohub’s pioneering work to combine frontier AI with frontier biology to solve disease and Learning Commons’ mission to build AI infrastructure that aligns how students learn with the tools that shape their learning experiences.

Operations includes our Central Tech, Finance, Marketing & Communications, People, and Real Estate / Workplace / Events / Facilities / Security (REWFS) teams. Together, these teams create the systems, programs, and experiences that empower our partners and colleagues across Biohub and Learning Commons to drive impact.

This work requires strategic and operational rigor, creativity, and deep collaboration. Whether designing world-class employee experiences, safeguarding data and infrastructure, or shaping how we communicate our impact, Operations plays a critical role in helping deliver meaningful change at scale.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Project Manager, Marketing to help run how our team operates day to day. You’ll manage the systems, processes, and workflows — from intake and prioritization to project tracking — that let us ship creative and production work efficiently, at a high bar of quality, and at scale. This role reports to the Marketing Operations Lead, within the broader Marketing & Communications organization.

The ideal person for this role thinks in systems. You see a manual, repeatable task and know how to build an AI-assisted workflow that makes it faster and more reliable. You bring real judgment about how a creative team should operate, and you’re comfortable working without a blueprint — you’ll help figure out what processes the team needs and why, then build them.

What You’ll Do

Systems & Process

  • Build and maintain the systems — intake, project tracking, approvals, asset and file management — that keep the team running
  • Identify where AI can automate repetitive or manual work, from intake triage to status reporting, and build those workflows
  • Document workflows and playbooks so processes scale beyond any one person

Project & Workflow Management

  • Run day-to-day project management across the team’s creative and production work: intake, prioritization, timelines, and status tracking
  • Spot bottlenecks before they become blockers, and help redesign the process, not just patch the symptom
  • Keep multiple projects moving in parallel without letting details slip

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as the point of contact for teams submitting creative and production requests
  • Coordinate timelines and dependencies across creative, content, and partner teams
  • Maintain dashboards and reporting on capacity and project status

Events

  • Support logistics and planning for brand-related events, activations, or offsites as needed

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, marketing operations, or a similarly operational role, ideally supporting a brand, creative, or communications function
  • Proven experience building or deploying AI-powered tools or workflows that reduced manual work — you can point to specific things you’ve built, not just tools you’ve used
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented; you catch the things others miss
  • Self-motivated with strong follow-through; comfortable creating structure and process where none exists yet
  • Collaborative and easy to work with across a range of stakeholders and working styles
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfort working with project management/collaboration tools (e.g., Notion, Airtable, Jira)
  • Event planning or logistics experience is a plus

Compensation

The Redwood City, CA base pay range for a new hire in this role is $138,000- $189,200. New hires are typically hired into the lower portion of the range, enabling employee growth in the range over time. Actual placement in range is based on job-related skills and experience, as evaluated throughout the interview process.

This position may be eligible to participate in our discretionary annual performance bonus program. Bonus eligibility and targets are determined in accordance with our total rewards philosophy and may vary by role.

Better Together

As we grow, we’re excited to strengthen in-person connections and cultivate a collaborative, team-oriented environment. This role is a hybrid position requiring you to be onsite for at least 60% of the working month, approximately 3 days a week, with specific in-office days determined by the team’s manager. The exact schedule will be at the hiring manager’s discretion and communicated during the interview process.

Benefits for the Whole You

We’re thankful to have an incredible team behind our work. To honor their commitment, we offer a wide range of benefits to support the people who make all we do possible.

  • Provides a generous employer match on employee 401(k) contributions to support planning for the future.
  • Paid time off to volunteer at an organization of your choice.
  • Funding for select family-forming benefits.
  • Relocation support for employees who need assistance moving

If you’re interested in a role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with each qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply as you may be the perfect fit for this or another role.

jobs.title: Program Manager, GTM Acceleration
jobs.jd_full:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Program Manager to join our GTM Acceleration team. In this role, you’ll own the program management behind some of our highest-priority GTM initiatives and build the operating systems that turn important product releases into clear, timely action across the field.

You’ll lead complex programs like global enablement offsites, Sales Kickoff, Field Readiness Bootcamps, and other strategic GTM initiatives from planning through execution and follow-up. You’ll also own the process connecting Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) releases to GTM and ensure our teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and what they need to do differently.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Field Engineering, and Enablement. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional work, keep teams aligned against fixed deadlines, and give leaders clear visibility into progress, risks, and decisions.

This role is hybrid, based out of our SF office and includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday.

What You Will Do:

  • Program-manage Vercel’s highest-priority GTM initiatives—including global enablement offsites, Sales Kickoff, Field Readiness Bootcamps, and other strategic programs—from initial planning and workbacks through execution and follow-up.
  • Own the GTM enablement roadmap and calendar: intake, prioritization, sequencing, dependencies, readiness, conflicts, and regional coordination across programs.
  • Build and run the EPD-to-GTM release process for Tier 1 and Tier 2 launches, establishing clear owners, milestones, decisions, field ready supporting resources.
  • Enforce product-update communication standards across Slack and enablement channels, including the template, routing, timing, and exception path for urgent changes.
  • Provide leadership with a concise view of program status, risks, decisions, and dependencies without requiring them to chase updates.

About You:

  • You have 3+ years of experience in program management, strategy consulting, business operations, or a comparable cross-functional execution role, ideally in a fast-moving technology environment.
  • You have a track record of driving ambiguous, high-visibility programs with many contributors and fixed deadlines, and can bring structure to work that does not yet have a clear playbook.
  • An exceptional operator: you build clear plans, identify critical paths and dependencies, close open decisions, and reliably follow through from planning to execution.
  • Clear communicator who can influence senior cross-functional partners without formal authority
  • You understand enterprise B2B sales and GTM organizations well enough to anticipate what customer-facing teams need to be successful, and you can quickly develop fluency in technical products.
  • You look for ways to automate repetitive coordination and operational work, using AI and lightweight tooling to make processes faster and more scalable.
  • You thrive in environments with a high rate of change and are comfortable creating structure while the organization, product, and priorities continue to evolve.

Bonus If You:

  • Have worked at a B2B SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure, or cloud platform company.
  • Have experience with sales enablement, field readiness, product launch operations, or large-scale internal programs.
  • Have experience designing intake, communications, or governance systems across Product & GTM

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $144,000 - $198,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don’t necessarily check every box on the job description.
